Companion Animal Travel Desk Policy for Animal Acceptance and Handling

This section sets the minimum standards for booking, crate review, handling, and service fees for companion animals at Aurelia Skyways.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk shall apply these rules with care, recordkeeping, and consistent judgment so that staff members treat animals humanely and passengers receive accurate service. For a bird, the travel fee is $145 and the charge is taken as part of the booking record before departure. For a bird, the crate's longest side is 60 cm and staff shall reject any container that exceeds that limit. The desk shall confirm animal details at the time of reservation, and it shall enter the animal type, crate measurements, and fee status in the service record without delay. The senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions and resolves any exception that cannot be settled by the desk in the normal review process. Handlers shall use calm methods, avoid rough restraint, and keep movement quiet so that the animal remains safe and settled during intake and transfer.

Before travel, staff shall inspect the crate for secure latches, clean surfaces, and enough room for the animal to stand and turn without strain. If a crate fails the size rule, the booking shall not proceed until the traveler presents a compliant crate. If a traveler such as Andre Nguyen, Khalil Costa, or another customer arrives with a bird, staff shall verify the fee entry, explain the crate limit plainly, and complete the check with respect and patience. The cabin team monitors animals during flight and reports any distress, leakage, escape risk, or other welfare concern to the senior coordinator at once. Staff members shall not improvise handling methods, and they shall not place animals in conditions that create fear, unnecessary heat, or avoidable noise.

All service notes shall remain factual, complete, and free from casual language so that follow-up actions are clear. If an animal arrives without the required crate condition or with incomplete booking information, the desk shall record the issue and route the matter to the senior coordinator for direction. If Mia, or any other animal, shows signs of agitation, staff shall pause the process, reassess the environment, and continue only after the animal is stable. Aurelia Skyways expects the Companion Animal Travel Desk to protect animal welfare first, maintain fair treatment for customers, and keep each decision aligned with this policy.

For further guidance, contact the senior coordinator, Companion Animal Travel Desk.
